entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Mongolia.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una fecha de caducidad al menos 6 meses después de tu llegada a Mongolia.
entry.quote: To enter Mongolia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: Make sure the border control officer stamps your passport, or you could face issues when leaving.
entry.es: Asegúrate de que el agente fronterizo selle tu pasaporte, o podrías tener problemas al salir.
entry.quote: Make sure the border control officer puts a stamp in your passport or you could face issues when leaving the country.

entry.en: Independent travellers must register themselves with the Mongolian Immigration Agency, which issues a digital residence permit to carry at all times.
entry.es: Los viajeros independientes deben registrarse en la Agencia de Inmigración de Mongolia, que emite un permiso de residencia digital que se debe llevar siempre.
entry.quote: If you are travelling independently or staying with friends, you must register yourself with the Mongolian Immigration Agency.

entry.en: Foreign nationals are not routinely allowed access to border areas, and zones up to 100km inside the border can count as border areas needing permission.
entry.es: A los extranjeros no se les permite normalmente el acceso a zonas fronterizas, y áreas de hasta 100 km dentro de la frontera pueden requerir permiso.
entry.quote: The authorities can regard zones of up to 100km inside the border as a border area. If you wish to travel in these areas, you must get permission from the State Frontier Guard Authority.

entry.en: You can take in up to 15 million Mongolian tugriks.
entry.es: Puedes ingresar hasta 15 millones de tugriks mongoles.
entry.quote: You can take in up to 15 million in Mongolian tugriks.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 US dollars or more must be declared, or the money could be seized when you leave.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viaje por 10.000 dólares o más deben declararse, o el dinero podría ser confiscado al salir.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 US dollars or more. You will get a certified declaration to show you brought it with you. If you do not, your money could be seized when you leave.

safety.en: Pickpockets may operate in markets and crowded places, with higher risk during Tsagaan Sar and Naadam.
safety.es: Los carteristas pueden actuar en mercados y lugares concurridos, con mayor riesgo durante Tsagaan Sar y Naadam.
safety.quote: Pickpockets may operate in markets and crowded public places. The risk increases during the festivals of Tsagaan Sar (New Year, celebrated from December to February) and Naadam (July).

safety.en: Violent incidents are rare, but foreigners have been assaulted and robbed in Ulaanbaatar, so avoid being out alone at night.
safety.es: Los incidentes violentos son raros, pero se ha agredido y robado a extranjeros en Ulaanbaatar; evita salir solo de noche.
safety.quote: Violent incidents are rare, but foreigners have been assaulted and robbed in Ulaanbaatar. Avoid being out alone at night

safety.en: It is illegal to photograph or video police, police escorts or military personnel.
safety.es: Es ilegal fotografiar o grabar a la policía, sus escoltas o al personal militar.
safety.quote: It is illegal to photograph or video police, police escorts or military personnel.

safety.en: There are a high number of road accidents in Mongolia, and only about 10% of roads outside the capital are tarmacked.
safety.es: Hay un gran número de accidentes de tráfico en Mongolia, y solo alrededor del 10% de las carreteras fuera de la capital están asfaltadas.
safety.quote: Outside the capital, only about 10% of the country’s roads are tarmacked and signposting is minimal.

safety.en: Weather ranges from +35°C in summer to -40°C in winter and changes often without warning.
safety.es: El clima va de +35°C en verano a -40°C en invierno y cambia a menudo sin aviso.
safety.quote: Mongolia is a huge country with varying weather conditions from +35°C in summer to -40°C in winter and during the nights. Weather conditions often change without warning.

safety.en: Same-sex relationships are not illegal but are not generally accepted socially.
safety.es: Las relaciones entre personas del mismo sexo no son ilegales, pero en general no son aceptadas socialmente.
safety.quote: Although not illegal, same-sex relationships are not generally accepted socially.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Mongolia.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo en partes de Mongolia.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a risk in parts of Mongolia.

health.en: High air pollution in Ulaanbaatar, especially in winter, may aggravate bronchial, sinus or asthma conditions.
health.es: La alta contaminación del aire en Ulaanbaatar, sobre todo en invierno, puede agravar problemas bronquiales, sinusales o asma.
health.quote: The high levels of air pollution in Ulaanbaatar, especially in winter, may aggravate bronchial, sinus or asthma conditions.

health.en: It is best to bring prescription medication and a first aid kit, as pharmacy products are mainly from China and Russia.
health.es: Lo mejor es llevar medicación recetada y un botiquín, ya que los productos de las farmacias son principalmente de China y Rusia.
health.quote: It is best to bring prescription medication and a first aid kit with you. Medical products in pharmacies are mainly from China and Russia

health.en: Outside Ulaanbaatar healthcare is limited and doctors may not speak English.
health.es: Fuera de Ulaanbaatar la atención médica es limitada y los médicos pueden no hablar inglés.
health.quote: Outside Ulaanbaatar, the standard of healthcare is limited, and doctors may not speak English.

health.en: At hospitals you have to pay 80% of the treatment cost in advance.
health.es: En los hospitales hay que pagar por adelantado el 80% del coste del tratamiento.
health.quote: At hospitals, you will have to pay 80% of the treatment cost in advance.

health.en: Tap water is unsafe to drink.
health.es: El agua del grifo no es segura para beber.
health.quote: Tap water is unsafe to drink.

help.en: Emergency numbers are ambulance 103, fire 101 and police 102.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 103, bomberos 101 y policía 102.

help.en: Police can be called on 102, or +976 102 from an international mobile phone, with someone available who speaks English.
help.es: Se puede llamar a la policía al 102, o al +976 102 desde un móvil internacional, y debería haber alguien que hable inglés.
help.quote: In an emergency call the police on 102 or +976 102 from an international mobile phone. There should be someone available on this number who can speak to you in English.

getting_in.en: Chinggis Khaan International Airport in Ulaanbaatar is connected to major hubs in eastern Asia, Istanbul and Frankfurt.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Chinggis Khaan de Ulaanbaatar conecta con grandes centros de Asia oriental, Estambul y Fráncfort.
getting_in.quote: Chinggis Khaan International Airport (UBN  IATA) in Ulaanbaatar is now connected to some major airport hubs in eastern Asia and Istanbul and Frankfurt.

getting_in.en: The Trans-Mongolian Line of the Trans-Siberian Railway links Ulaanbaatar with Moscow and Beijing.
getting_in.es: La línea Transmongoliana del Transiberiano une Ulaanbaatar con Moscú y Pekín.
getting_in.quote: The Trans-Mongolian Line of the legendary Trans-Siberian Railway links Ulaanbaatar with Moscow, Russia and Beijing, China.

getting_in.en: The Beijing to Ulaanbaatar train has a mandatory stop of 3-4 hours at Erlian while the bogies are switched.
getting_in.es: El tren de Pekín a Ulaanbaatar hace una parada obligatoria de 3-4 horas en Erlian para cambiar los bogies.
getting_in.quote: There are two trains a week and the ride takes almost 30 hours, including a mandatory stop of 3-4 hours at Erlian while the train bogies are switched between Russian broad gauge and Chinese standard gauge.

getting_in.en: At the border, people in uniform may try to sell you 'required travel insurance', which does not exist.
getting_in.es: En la frontera, personas uniformadas pueden intentar venderte un 'seguro de viaje obligatorio', que no existe.
getting_in.quote: Be wary of scams at the border where people in uniform will attempt to sell you "required travel insurance." There is no such thing and you can safely ignore them.

getting_in.en: The Altanbulag-Kyakhta (Sühbaatar) border crossing with Russia is open 24 hours a day.
getting_in.es: El paso fronterizo de Altanbulag-Kyakhta (Sühbaatar) con Rusia está abierto las 24 horas.
getting_in.quote: The main border is in Altanbulag-Kyakhta (Sühbaatar), nearest to the capital, is open 24 hours a day.

getting_in.en: Walking across the Russia-Mongolia border is prohibited at Naushki, but travellers can arrange for Mongolia-bound cars to take them across.
getting_in.es: Cruzar a pie la frontera Rusia-Mongolia en Naushki está prohibido, pero se puede arreglar que un coche con destino a Mongolia te cruce.
getting_in.quote: Walking across the border is prohibited, but travellers have no problems arranging for Mongolia-bound cars to take them across the border

getting_around.en: The easiest way to travel long distance is via the domestic airlines AeroMongolia or Hunnu Air.
getting_around.es: La forma más fácil de viajar largas distancias es con las aerolíneas nacionales AeroMongolia o Hunnu Air.
getting_around.quote: The easiest way to travel long distance is via one of the domestic airlines: AeroMongolia or Hunnu Air.

getting_around.en: AeroMongolia charges foreigners significantly more than locals, while Hunnu has only one price.
getting_around.es: AeroMongolia cobra a los extranjeros bastante más que a los locales, mientras que Hunnu tiene un solo precio.
getting_around.quote: AeroMongolia uses a two-tier price structure, charging foreigners significantly more than locals, while Hunnu has only one price.

getting_around.en: Mongolian trains are extremely slow, and intercity buses on parallel paved roads are much faster.
getting_around.es: Los trenes mongoles son extremadamente lentos, y los autobuses interurbanos por carreteras asfaltadas paralelas son mucho más rápidos.
getting_around.quote: Trains are extremely slow. They usually leave on time, and arrive on time or less than 20 minutes late. Intercity bus routes on the roughly parallel paved roads will get you there much faster.

getting_around.en: Bus tickets are sold in the station, credit cards are not accepted, and your passport is required to buy a ticket.
getting_around.es: Los billetes de autobús se venden en la estación, no se acepta tarjeta de crédito y se necesita el pasaporte para comprarlos.
getting_around.quote: Tickets are sold in the station, not in the coach.

getting_around.en: Public countryside taxis and minivans are more dangerous than coaches and trains and always overloaded.
getting_around.es: Los taxis y minibuses rurales públicos son más peligrosos que los autobuses y trenes y siempre van sobrecargados.
getting_around.quote: They are more dangerous than coaches and trains, and always overloaded.

getting_around.en: City taxis should charge about 2000 ₮ per km as of 2026, with the driver setting the trip meter.
getting_around.es: Los taxis urbanos deberían cobrar unos 2000 ₮ por km en 2026, y el conductor pone el taxímetro.
getting_around.quote: In the cities, taxis should charge about 2000 ₮ per km as of 2026. The drivers will set their trip meter and charge accordingly.

money.en: The currency is the tögrög (₮, MNT), which loses 8-10% of its value in an average year.
money.es: La moneda es el tögrög (₮, MNT), que pierde entre un 8 y un 10% de su valor en un año medio.
money.quote: The tögrög suffers from persistent high inflation, losing 8-10% in an average year.

money.en: It is virtually impossible to exchange tögrög outside the country, so do not exchange too much.
money.es: Es prácticamente imposible cambiar tögrög fuera del país, así que no cambies demasiado.
money.quote: It is virtually impossible to exchange tögrög outside the country, so don't exchange too much.

money.en: US dollars are widely accepted in the tourist industry for larger payments but are not usable in the countryside.
money.es: Los dólares estadounidenses se aceptan ampliamente en el turismo para pagos grandes, pero no sirven en el campo.
money.quote: US dollars are widely accepted in the tourist industry, especially for larger payments (hotels, guides, etc.), but are not usable in the countryside.

money.en: Tipping is rarely expected except in tourism-related services like tour guides.
money.es: Rara vez se espera propina, salvo en servicios turísticos como los guías.
money.quote: In Mongolia tipping is rarely expected except in tourism-related services like tour guides.

money.en: Narantuul market in Ulaanbaatar has the lowest prices, but beware of pickpockets and even attackers.
money.es: El mercado Narantuul de Ulaanbaatar tiene los precios más bajos, pero hay que cuidarse de carteristas e incluso agresores.
money.quote: Beware of the many pickpockets and even attackers there.

money.en: It is illegal to take antiques out of the country without a special permit.
money.es: Es ilegal sacar antigüedades del país sin un permiso especial.
money.quote: It is illegal to take antiques out of the country without a special permit.

etiquette.en: Receive items with the right hand, palm facing up, and refusing a gift is very rude.
etiquette.es: Recibe los objetos con la mano derecha y la palma hacia arriba; rechazar un regalo es muy descortés.
etiquette.quote: Always receive items with the right hand, palm facing up. Drink from the right hand with the palm up as well.  It is very rude to refuse a gift.

etiquette.en: Never point at anyone with your index finger, since it implies disrespect.
etiquette.es: Nunca señales a nadie con el dedo índice, ya que implica falta de respeto.
etiquette.quote: Never point at anyone with your index finger since it implies disrespect.

etiquette.en: If you accidentally tap someone's foot with yours, shake hands immediately or it will be seen as an insult.
etiquette.es: Si tocas por accidente el pie de alguien con el tuyo, dale la mano de inmediato o se verá como un insulto.
etiquette.quote: If by accident you tap someone's foot with yours, immediately shake hands with them (failing to do so will be seen as an insult).

etiquette.en: Do not whistle inside a ger or stand on or lean over the threshold.
etiquette.es: No silbes dentro de una ger ni pises o te apoyes sobre el umbral.
etiquette.quote:
Whistle inside a ger
Stand on, or lean over, the threshold

etiquette.en: Fire is sacred to Mongolians, so do not stamp it out or put water or rubbish on it.
etiquette.es: El fuego es sagrado para los mongoles, así que no lo pisotees ni le eches agua o basura.
etiquette.quote: Stamp out a fire, or put water or any rubbish on it (fire is sacred to Mongolians)

etiquette.en: Anti-China sentiment is high, so avoid wearing anything associated with China or talking about China.
etiquette.es: El sentimiento anti-chino es alto, así que evita llevar algo asociado a China o hablar de China.
etiquette.quote: Anti-China sentiment is high in Mongolia due to historiographical and cultural disputes, and because China is seen by Mongolians as a colonial oppressor. As such, refrain from wearing anything associated with China, and refrain from talking about China.

connectivity.en: Larger population centers have mobile coverage, but do not expect signal on the steppes.
connectivity.es: Los grandes núcleos de población tienen cobertura móvil, pero no esperes señal en las estepas.
connectivity.quote: All larger population centers in Mongolia have mobile phone coverage, but don't expect signal out on the endless steppes.

connectivity.en: Mobicom generally has the best coverage but is more complex to set up than Unitel, and you should bring your passport.
connectivity.es: Mobicom suele tener la mejor cobertura pero es más complejo de configurar que Unitel, y hay que llevar el pasaporte.
connectivity.quote: Mobicom is generally reckoned to have the best coverage, although it is more complex to set up than Unitel.

connectivity.en: As of 2026, Mobicom offers 30 GB of data for 30 days costing 30,000 ₮.
connectivity.es: En 2026, Mobicom ofrece 30 GB de datos durante 30 días por 30.000 ₮.
connectivity.quote: As of 2026, Mobicom offers 30 GB of data for 30 days costing 30,000 ₮.

connectivity.en: Wifi is widely available in hotels, restaurants and bars, especially in Ulaanbaatar.
connectivity.es: El wifi está muy disponible en hoteles, restaurantes y bares, sobre todo en Ulaanbaatar.
connectivity.quote: wifi is widely available in hotels, restaurants and bars, especially in Ulaanbaatar. You can buy local SIM cards and mobile phones.
